name: Cepheus Protocol Anthology Season 1
source:
Cepheus Protocol: Anthology is a linear limited edition prose featuring the first twelve chapters of the Novelization, visual novel. Experience the outbreak of the Pangu Virus from multiple perspectives as the brave heroes of the Center for Epidemic Research and Control battle tirelessly to stop the spread of a cataclysmic alien virus that has mutated innocent people into monstrous creatures of unimaginable power with a single-minded goal spread.

Told from various perspectives of the outbreak, before and during, discover how the Pangu Virus was discovered, what led to the creation of the C.E.R.C., how the virus came to American shores, and who is Patient Zero. As the outbreak spreads, millions of innocent lives hang in the balance. Every day, the virus becomes more virulent as it progresses to its true nature.

Faced with a threat it was never meant to fight will the heroes of the C.E.R.C. be strong enough to save not just a city but prevent the extinction of the human race? See for yourself in this eye-catching visual novel that allows you to explore Cepheus Protocol's frightening events like never before.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707120/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《仙王座協議：故事集》是一部限量發行、採用線性敘事的視覺小說，收錄了小說版的前十二章。你將從多個視角體驗盤古病毒的爆發過程，見證流行病研究與控制中心的勇敢英雄們不知疲倦地奮戰，阻止這場災難性的外星病毒擴散。它讓無辜的人變成了力量強大到難以想像的怪物，而這些怪物只有一個目標：繼續傳播病毒。

故事從疫情爆發前與爆發期間的不同視角展開，揭示盤古病毒如何被發現、流行病研究與控制中心（C.E.R.C.）為何成立、病毒如何來到美國，以及零號病人究竟是誰。隨著疫情擴散，數百萬無辜者的生命危在旦夕。病毒每天都變得更加兇險，逐漸顯露出真正的本質。

面對一個從未為之做好準備的威脅，C.E.R.C.的英雄們是否足夠強大，既能拯救城市，又能阻止人類滅絕？這部引人注目的視覺小說，將帶你以前所未有的方式深入《仙王座協議》中令人恐懼的事件，親自尋找答案。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707120/]Steam[/url]]
